style: Photorealistic industrial editorial photography. Neutral natural light, credible present-day workplaces; no robots, drones, holograms or floating UI. Website overlays illustrative reference disclaimer.

scenes.prompt: Two engineering consultants and a customer project manager reviewing a printed process map, document register and construction schedule in a practical site office overlooking an industrial facility. One navy jacket has a small Nordic Labs Tech Oy text patch.
An IT engineer configuring a rack server in a clean ordinary enterprise server room, laptop nearby, realistic cables and hardware.

An integration engineer and a document controller at two monitors in a modern industrial office. Screens show generic document registers, procurement tables and warehouse records, no readable text or brand logos.

A project engineer reviewing engineering drawings and requirement checklists with a software specialist at a desk, engineering document on paper alongside a computer showing a restrained generic structured review.

A construction planner and procurement manager comparing printed delivery records, warehouse material lists and a project schedule in a site office. Careful human verification of matching records, industrial site through window.

A Nordic Labs Tech Oy consultant wearing a navy shirt with small text patch training customer engineering and operations staff around a large monitor with a generic project reporting dashboard. Professional calm collaboration in a real office.
